the converted runner opens its own pipeline_runs ledger row on a run that owns its ledger (openLedgerRow, scripts/lib/step/ledger.js:221-235; ledger_row "owned"); the legacy PRE wrote none in this scenario (standalone).

stdout is log text: the converted runner logs under the [address_points] tag with its own target/gate/phase lines (scripts/lib/step/index.js:296, :4783) where the legacy script logged its own lines, so line-by-line text differs (sources 32→3 lines; standalone 14→3 lines). NOT CODE: the night's runtime edits are runLinkPhase extra_counters (R-IG; this step declares none, so no key and no behaviour change, lock type-counters T6) and descriptor/notes/guard text that no runner reads at run time; they move lib_fingerprint (fef97e27 -> 93b059a9) and source_fingerprint, not this output.
